description: This file provides utility functions for handling generated output files within a build process, including writing files if changed and reporting status via CLI.

methods.name: writeGeneratedOutput
methods.description: Writes the specified output content to a file if it differs from the current content, based on parameters.

methods.name: reportGeneratedOutputCli
methods.description: Reports the status of generated output in CLI, checks if output is stale, and logs or exits accordingly.
